title: Beyond Words Alone: Disentangling Distributed Evidence for Visually Grounded Cultural Translation
abstract: arXiv:2610.35482v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Social media enables cross-lingual communication, yet the meaning of user-generated content (UGC) is often distributed across text, images, and cultural knowledge, making translation challenging. Existing evaluations typically treat images as optional and assume textual information is sufficient, obscuring whether errors stem from missing visual evidence or inadequate cultural adaptation. We introduce \textbf{Culture-MMT}, a diagnostic benchmark for \textbf{distributed-evidence pragmatic reconstruction} in social-media translation. It contains 498 curated, de-identified UGC instances across 20 domains, categorized into Symbol, Visual, and Hybrid by their required evidence. We also develop a human-aligned domain-specific judge, Judger, and a controlled evaluation framework that systematically varies the evidence available to translators. Across 17 model configurations, real images improve performance by +0.280 on Visual and +0.197 on Hy

translated_title: 超越文字本身：面向视觉接地文化翻译的分布式证据解耦
translated_abstract: 社交媒体使跨语言交流成为可能，但用户生成内容（UGC）的含义往往分布于文本、图像与文化知识之中，这给翻译带来了挑战。现有评估通常将图像视为可选内容，并假设文本信息已经足够，从而掩盖了翻译错误究竟是源于视觉证据的缺失还是文化适应的不足。我们提出了 Culture-MMT，一个用于社交媒体翻译中“分布式证据语用重建”的诊断基准。该基准包含498个经过精心筛选、去标识化的UGC实例，覆盖20个领域，并根据所需证据类型划分为符号、视觉和混合三类。我们还开发了一个与人类判断对齐的领域专用评审器 Judger，以及一个能够系统性改变翻译模型可用证据的受控评估框架。在17种模型配置上的实验表明，真实图像在视觉类任务上带来 +0.280 的性能提升，在混合类任务上带来 +0.197 的提升。
tldr: 本文提出 Culture-MMT 诊断基准，通过系统解耦社交媒体翻译中分散于文本、图像与文化知识中的证据，证明视觉证据对于实现文化适配的翻译至关重要。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Culture-MMT, a diagnostic benchmark that systematically disentangles evidence distributed across text, images, and cultural knowledge in social media translation, demonstrating that visual evidence is crucial for culturally grounded translation.
